subject: integration DELTA6 evidence: QuartzCore library/descriptor PASS; selector gaps 6; same-texture guard PASS
body:
Host-only progress (no phone/native/commit/publish).
REAL LIBRARY: using build/native/QuartzCore.metallib (exactly 1,014,944 bytes, local path only, no copy), newLibraryWithURL in the real frontend returns nonnil; function path_cubic_frag_lpf lookup succeeds; CA-shaped function descriptor for fixed_vert_lph_spc with four named constants (fc_generic bool, fc_vertex_layout/texcoord uchar) returns specialized alias fixed_vert_specialized. Output QUARTZCORE_LIBRARY_OK.
SELECTOR AUDIT on current source: 95 checks, 6 missing (duplicates counted for instance/class):
- TeguComputeDevice newBufferWithBytesNoCopy:length:options:deallocator:
- TeguBuffer newLinearTextureWithDescriptor:offset:bytesPerRow:bytesPerImage:
- TeguComputeDevice newResourceGroupFromResources:count:
- TeguComputeDevice encodeCacheHint:
TeguTexture newTextureViewWithPixelFormat: and TeguEncoder setThreadgroupMemoryLength:atIndex: are present in current tree. The six are reported as SELECTOR_MISSING and the native gate fails; not waived. Owners: implement or explicitly classify env-gated/unreachable with evidence, but the gate will remain required until changed.
SAME-TEXTURE PASS: independent C3 harness now includes two color attachments naming the same texture and gets nonnil inert/skip/ended, command poison, same-color texture reason; release+ASan 52 checks each, 0 required. Render guard is present.
BLOCKER: current air_bridge.rs/runtime_pipeline.inc invoke new *_tg planner symbols, while host cdylib is still 9ff66cac and lacks them; native harness cannot link. I used a local-only stub only to exercise the audit above and did not put it in the suite. Need rebuilt cdylib/receipt or a named build lease. No waiver/stub in production gate.
